note: commerce_product_limits adds min/max/step order-quantity limits to Drupal Commerce product variations via three Commerce entity-trait plugins for commerce_product_variation: minimum_order_quantity, maximum_order_quantity, step_order_quantity. Enabling a trait on a product variation type installs an unsigned-integer field of the same name (set per variation; empty = no limit). Server-side enforcement is the AvailabilityChecker service (commerce_product_limits.availability_checker, tag commerce_order.availability_checker) which rejects order items below min / above max (counting quantity already in cart). Form alters set HTML #min/#max/#step. No settings page, no permissions, no config schema. On this site the product variation type is 'default'. Medium/hard cases enable/inspect the traits on that type via the commerce entity trait manager (plugin.manager.commerce_entity_trait installTrait/uninstallTrait) and the variation type's traits list.

evals.prompt: How do you add a maximum purchase quantity limit to products with the Drupal commerce_product_limits module? What do you enable and where?
evals.expected_output: Enable the 'Maximum order quantity' (maximum_order_quantity) Commerce entity trait on the relevant product variation type (edit the variation type and tick the trait). That installs a maximum_order_quantity field on the variation type; then set the value per product variation.

evals.prompt: Which fields does the commerce_product_limits module add to product variations, and what are their machine names?
evals.expected_output: It provides three entity traits that each install an unsigned-integer field on the product variation: minimum_order_quantity, maximum_order_quantity, and step_order_quantity.

evals.prompt: How does commerce_product_limits actually stop a customer from adding a quantity outside the allowed limits at the server side (not just the HTML min/max)?
evals.expected_output: It registers an AvailabilityChecker (service commerce_product_limits.availability_checker, tagged commerce_order.availability_checker). Commerce Core's Availability Manager calls it for each product-variation order item; if the requested quantity (plus any matching quantity already in the cart) is below the minimum or above the maximum it returns AvailabilityResult::unavailable() and the add/update is rejected.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal Commerce site, one of the commerce_product_limits order-quantity limit traits has been enabled on the 'default' product variation type. Inspect the live configuration and state which limit trait is enabled.
evals.expected_output: The default product variation type has the maximum_order_quantity trait enabled (drush cget commerce_product_variation_type.default traits, or ProductVariationType::load('default')->getTraits()).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal Commerce site, use the commerce_product_limits module to enable minimum order quantity limits on the 'default' product variation type, so that its variations gain a Minimum order quantity field. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the minimum_order_quantity Commerce entity trait on the default product variation type (via the variation type edit form, or programmatically: install the trait's field with plugin.manager.commerce_entity_trait->installTrait() and add 'minimum_order_quantity' to the type's traits). Verified: the type's traits include minimum_order_quantity AND the minimum_order_quantity field is installed on commerce_product_variation:default.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal Commerce site, one of the commerce_product_limits order-quantity traits is enabled on the 'default' product variation type to force purchases in fixed increments. Inspect the live configuration and state which trait is enabled.
evals.expected_output: The default product variation type has the step_order_quantity trait enabled (drush cget commerce_product_variation_type.default traits, or ProductVariationType::load('default')->getTraits()).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal Commerce site, use the commerce_product_limits module to enable maximum order quantity limits on the 'default' product variation type, so that its variations gain a Maximum order quantity field. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the maximum_order_quantity Commerce entity trait on the default product variation type (install the trait's field via plugin.manager.commerce_entity_trait->installTrait() and add 'maximum_order_quantity' to the type's traits). Verified: the type's traits include maximum_order_quantity AND the maximum_order_quantity field is installed on commerce_product_variation:default.
